consulta.metaTitulo: Check your obligations with your pet
consulta.metaDescripcion: Four steps, no sign-up: find out what Spanish law requires of you today, in your municipality, with your dog, cat or ferret, with the law and article behind each obligation.
consulta.titulo: What does the law require of me, today, with my animal?
consulta.entradilla: We tell you what can really be enforced and what cannot, with the law and the article behind each point.

especie.texto: Choose a species to start. You can change it later.
especie.listadoTexto: Act 7/2023 provides for a positive list of species that can be kept as pets, but it has not been published yet. For this species the result will be very limited: the laws we have verified mainly refer to dogs, cats and ferrets.

municipio.texto: Obligations change with the region and the town council: this is what affects the result the most.
municipio.ayuda: Search by name. Accents and typos are fine.
municipio.rapidos: Or choose one of the largest cities
municipio.avisoOrdenanza: We have not loaded any local by-law yet. Anything that depends only on your town council will show as "not verified yet", never as "does not apply".

animal.texto: The more you tell us, the more precise the result. "I don't know" is a valid answer: we would rather say so than give you an answer that might be wrong.
animal.nombreAyuda: Only to personalise the text. We do not store it and it is left out when you copy the link.
animal.edadAyuda: No need for the exact date.
animal.razaAyuda: If you don't know or it is a mixed breed, leave it blank: we will treat it as unknown, not as a "no".
animal.razaSinResultados: That breed is not in Annex I of Royal Decree 287/2002. Answer the question below.
animal.razaPpp: This breed is listed in Annex I of Royal Decree 287/2002: it is considered potentially dangerous.
animal.pppAyuda: It is if it belongs to a breed in Annex I or its crosses, if it has the features in Annex II, or if the authorities have declared it so because of its behaviour.
animal.uso: What do you keep it for?
animal.animalesHogar: How many animals live at home?

resumen.vacio: It fills in as you answer.
resumen.privacidad: We do not store your check: it only lives in this page's address.

consulta.sinJs: The check needs JavaScript to calculate your result. Meanwhile, you can see what your region or municipality requires on their pages.

resultado.hoy: Checked against the law in force on {fecha}
resultado.ojoTexto: It can be enforced today where you live.
resultado.pendienteTexto: The law states it, but it depends on a regulation that has not been published yet. When it is, you will see it in Changes.
resultado.sinDatosTexto: We are not saying it does not apply to you: we are saying we do not know for sure yet.
resultado.noAplicaTexto: Based on what you told us.
resultado.ordenanzaTitulo: {municipio}'s local by-law is not loaded yet
resultado.ordenanzaTexto: Anything that depends only on your town council (fees, census, dog areas, beaches…) has not been verified yet. If you know the by-law, help us add it.
resultado.especieLimitada: The regional laws we have verified explicitly name dogs, cats and, in some cases, ferrets. For other species some of them refer to a regulation we have not reviewed yet: if you see "Does not affect you", confirm it with your region.
resultado.avisoEnlace: The link reproduces this check. It does not include your animal's name.
resultado.faltanDatosTexto: Go back and choose the species and the municipality.
resultado.municipioDesconocidoTexto: We could not identify that municipality. Go back to step 2 and pick it from the list.

tarjeta.faltanDatos: This point is affected by something you marked as "I don't know".
tarjeta.sinFundamento: This obligation does not have its legal basis loaded yet. Do not rely on it until we can quote the law.
tarjeta.sinDatosCta: Do you know the rule? Tell us

traza.fuera_de_vigencia: A {ambito} rule is not in force on the date of the check.
traza.condiciones_no_cumplidas: A {ambito} rule does not apply to your animal because of its characteristics.
traza.condiciones_indeterminadas: A {ambito} rule could not be evaluated because of something you marked as "I don't know".
traza.menos_especifica: A {ambito} rule gives way to another one from a level closer to you.
traza.menos_restrictiva: At the same level, the stricter rule prevails over this {ambito} rule.
traza.menor_prioridad: Another rule at the same level prevails over this {ambito} rule.
traza.vigencia_mas_antigua: Another, more recent rule at the same level prevails over this {ambito} rule.
traza.dudaRelevante: There is a {ambito} rule that would affect you, but we cannot evaluate it without something you marked as "I don't know". We would rather say so than give you an answer that might be wrong.
traza.dependeTerritorio: It depends on what your region or your town council says, and we have not verified it for your municipality yet.
traza.sinEvaluar: No rule could be evaluated with the data available.
traza.sinReglas: There is no verified rule that applies to this case.
traza.noAplica: There are rules for this obligation, all of them could be evaluated and none affects you based on your data.
traza.revisadas: {n, plural, one {We reviewed # rule} other {We reviewed # rules}} from your region and the national level.
traza.metodo: How we resolve conflicts between laws
